spotify.isSignedIn.description: Checks whether Cuebot is signed in to your Spotify account.
spotify.isSignedIn.returns: true when signed in, otherwise false.

spotify.addToQueue.description: Adds a song to your Spotify queue. Great for song requests. Fails with an error when no song is found or Spotify says no (for example, nothing is playing).

parameters.song: A song name to search for, like "Never Gonna Give You Up", or a Spotify song link (open.spotify.com/track/...).

spotify.addToQueue.returns: The song that was added: title, artist, uri (Spotify's id for it) and link.
